limitations: All 30 libraries and 600 source items were adjudicated before any model predictions. Resolved means each review disagreement has a recorded decision, including explicit ambiguity; it is not a claim of human validation or certain semantic truth.

Sources are releases/v1/inputs.json, verified to match the exact reviewed projections: training mf01–mf18 from batch-02, development mf19–mf24 from batch-01, and amended test mf25–mf30 from batch-03. Selections refer to those latest review versions or their matching reviewer-a.json/reviewer-b.json aggregates. The parent workflow must bind final source/review/decision hashes before freezing.

Only the applicable contracts, repository safety rules, projected/latest source inputs and independent reviews were inspected. No author labels, authoring files, model predictions or production implementation were inspected.

Project granularity follows the original Organization contract and updated MatcherFeasibility contract. Garment, chapter, format and event-workstream codes do not establish independent projects by themselves. Shared facilities or subject matter likewise do not establish one project without continuing-identity evidence.

Membership versus a related-project reference is judgment-sensitive. Existing-template attribution usually remains only in the receiving project's membership; shared procurement, physical transfer, joint inspection and explicit result comparison can concern both projects. Per-library reasons record the actual source-grounded decision rather than using a universal new-update requirement.

Particularly judgment-sensitive decisions include mf01-i04, mf02-i15, mf07-i10, mf25-i07, mf26's exhibition relationship, mf28's shared service bay, and mf30-i06. These are resolved conservatively or through supplied distinctive evidence, but another careful annotator may disagree.

mf28 is custom because both reviewers inferred tournament membership through a service bay that also serves another undertaking. i02/i09 remain in coverage as ambiguous; i13 belongs to Open Hoops; the related edge reflects shared bay use without propagating event membership.
Ambiguity is source-specific and reassessed after context merges. mf03-i08, mf15-i03/i20, mf17-i02 and mf30-i06 do not require selecting an internal subtask once their project identity is supported.

No fixed per-library group count, related-edge count or bridge count was imposed. Some libraries validly have two contexts, no bridges or no related pairs. Corpus-level coverage and structural validation remain required.

These are agent-reviewed synthetic English data, not a deployment-representative or human-validated sample. Shared model-family errors, patterned writing and source-authoring regularities remain limitations despite independent review and adjudication.

Original authoring, sources and all reviews are preserved.
